description: Every training run behind a number in the paper: run tag, seed, the environment switches src/DataFeed.py reads, and for each run directory the arguments train_cmkd.py recorded (args.json) and the per-slot test metrics it wrote at the end of training (eval_results.npz: top-1/3/5 accuracy and DBA score for slots t..t+6, as fractions). Vision-only runs (train_vision_only.py) record no arguments; their launchers are listed. scripts/train_command.py prints the training command of any tag from this file.

families.used_for: Tables I-II; every contrast with range-angle alone
Table I teacher row; Table II; source of the RA+DA and enlarged-gap distillation (seed 42); supplementary S11 fusion table (phase 1)
distillation sources: _v3rd_teacher (all RA+RD distillation), teachers 1 and 2 of the teacher-seed replication (Sec. VII-A, supplementary S10)

families.family: Concatenation teacher, range-Doppler, and its distillation
RA student distilled from the Doppler-angle teacher

families.used_for: supplementary S10 (nine seeds; seed 9 did not finish)
supplementary S10 (temperature sweep at seed 42; ten seeds at temperature 1)

families.launcher: run_w5_radarteacher.sh (radar-only teacher arms); the other arms: scripts/train_command.py
run_grid.sh (collapse, binarization), run_m5.sh (RD rows permuted); DA rows permuted: scripts/train_command.py

families.used_for: Sec. V-B and supplementary S14 (all-zero second map)
Sec. V-B; supplementary S6 (screening: _s31rd_s42, _s1, _s2 before the replication)
families.launcher: run_s31.sh (window preparation; screening seeds); the ten-seed arms: scripts/train_command.py
